Use only the frozen current PR/P16 first-party source snapshots and existing materially relevant native dependency proofs. New foreign packages, unrelated features, other snapshots, speculative inventory and whole unrelated modules still require Root-specific reconciliation before analysis.

Source/path/hash/count, old owner verdict or counterpart alone never proves producer closure. Exact actual counterpart body/complete delta plus explicitly compared current definition/producer/recipient contract may support a same-contract carry; label it honestly instead of claiming fresh body reads.

Keep a local ordered source/range extension registry. Root must reconcile all extensions into the cumulative authoritative source manifest and overlay before closing the producer gate, then dispatch the necessary owner-fit delta before admission. No later-lens credit comes from this registration.
